ModMetaData.name: RimJoust
ModMetaData.description:
Medieval tournaments for your colony. Two knights ride at each other with lances, a field of fighters settles it on foot with blunted maces, archers put three volleys into a straw butt, and a Grand Tournament chains all three events together and crowns a single champion on points.
Everything runs on markers you place. Two flags mark out the lists, a trophy post marks the melee ground, a line flag and a butt make the archery range. Build whatever you like around them, stands, walls, tents, banners. The mod follows your markers, so the arena is yours.
Mount your colonists with Giddy-Up and hold a tournament. Lances are handed out and taken back automatically. Armor and a shield keep a knight in the saddle longer, so equipment matters. Squires drag the fallen off the field, your free colonists come to watch from the stands, and knights from other factions can enter and ride against yours. Nothing that happens in the lists ever costs you faction goodwill.
The winner is crowned champion and names a Queen of Love and Beauty, which sometimes goes exactly as everyone expected and sometimes turns into a scandal nobody forgets. Past champions are kept in a hall of fame.
Tournaments hurt people, this is still RimWorld. There are sliders for that, and a button on the flag to call the whole thing off when it stops being fun.
Most of the buildings in the screenshots (tents, stands, walls) come from other mods, mostly Medieval Overhaul. They are not part of RimJoust, I just used them to build the arena.
BenFD
